caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair with a woven seat positioned centrally on a plain, light beige background. The chair has a straightforward construction, with four turned wooden legs and stretched cylindrical supports connecting the legs near their bases. The seat is square and made of woven material depicted in muted, earthy tones of tan and light brown. The chair’s backrest features several turned wooden spindles arranged vertically between two sturdy posts, which are finished with prominent finials. The arms of the chair are straight wooden rails attached to the backrest posts and the front legs, with additional short cylindrical supports below. The overall coloration of the wood is medium brown, with shading and fine lines indicating dimensional detail and texture. There is a thin rectangular border drawn a short distance from the edge of the paper, and the artist’s name, Isidore Goldberg, is signed in the lower right corner.
title: Chair
